Itemized Passive Description:
*Basic effect(s)*
- Ki +1 and ATK & DEF 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
- Launches an additional attack that has a high chance of becoming
a Super Attack
*Per "Wicked Bloodline" or "Terrifying Conquerors" Category ally
on the team (depending on which Category has more members)*
- ATK & DEF 50%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 200%)
- Chance of performing a critical hit, chance of evading enemy's
attack & damage reduction rate 5%{passiveImg:up_g} (up to 20%)
*When there are 3 "Wicked Bloodline" Category allies or
3 "Terrifying Conquerors" Category allies attacking in the same turn*
- All allies' ATK & DEF 30%{passiveImg:up_g}
- ATK 100%{passiveImg:up_g} when attacking
*When attacking with 12 or more Ki*
- ATK & DEF 150%{passiveImg:up_g}
